# transition

Transition the current state machine to a declared state.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `statement.transition` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Statements |
| Family | State Control |
| Monaco kind | `statement` |
| Format | `transition <state>` |
| Valid contexts | `state_handler` |
| Autocomplete | `transition state_name` |

## Example

